statements.sql:
SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "CustomerID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_customers"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "ProductID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "ProductID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_products"
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "SalesOrderID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "SalesOrderID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_sales_order_headers"
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "SalesOrderDetailID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "SalesOrderDetailID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_sales_order_details"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("OrderDate") as min_date,
  MAX("OrderDate") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_sales_order_headers"

SELECT "CustomerID"
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_customers"
SAMPLE ROW (10000 ROWS)
WHERE "CustomerID" IS NOT NULL

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "OrderDate", "TotalDue"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_sales_order_headers"
  ON "CustomerID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "OrderDate" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND "OrderDate" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "OrderDate" <= ?
AND "OrderDate" > ?

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "CustomerID", "PersonID", "StoreID", "TerritoryID"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_customers"
  ON "CustomerID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "SalesOrderID", "OrderDate", "DueDate", "OnlineOrderFlag", "CustomerID", "SalesPersonID", "TerritoryID", "BillToAddressID", "ShipToAddressID", "ShipMethodID", "CreditCardID", "CurrencyRateID", "SubTotal", "TaxAmt", "Freight", "TotalDue"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_sales_order_headers"
  ON "CustomerID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "OrderDate" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "OrderDate" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "OrderDate" <= ?
  AND "OrderDate" > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY "OrderDate" DESC, "SalesOrderID"
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "OrderDate" DESC, "SalesOrderID"
